entities.name: Qal Sisma
entities.description: Snowy, craggy mountain range on Tarkir; territory of the Temur Frontier and formerly the Atarka brood.

entities.name: Temur Frontier
entities.description: Semi-nomadic clan living in the Qal Sisma.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: Dragon whose arrival and brood caused the Melting Wilds and who conquered Qadat.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: Plane where the Qal Sisma lies.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Spirit Dragon who hibernated in a hedron crucible in the Valley of the Spirit Dragon for 1280 years.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: Planeswalker sent back in time from the Valley of the Spirit Dragon in 4559 AR who saved Ugin by encasing him in hedrons.

entities.name: Valley of the Spirit Dragon
entities.description: Site where Ugin hibernated in a hedron crucible, which was broken in 4559.

entities.name: Qadat, the Fire Rim
entities.description: Volcanic region between Tiansun and Temur lands, once home of the Efreeti and Jeskai, conquered by Atarka.

entities.name: Efreeti
entities.description: Former inhabitants of Qadat before Atarka conquered it.

entities.name: Melting Wilds
entities.description: Widespread melting of the Qal Sisma's icy reaches that accompanied Atarka's arrival.

entities.name: Zenith Day
entities.description: Annual observation at Summer Landing commemorating Temur survival and those lost to Atarka.

events.summary: Atarka arrives with her brood's storms, causing the Melting Wilds, and conquers Qadat.
events.quote: the arrival of Atarka and the storms that birthed her brood were accompanied by widespread melting of the icy reaches in the Qal Sisma Mountains

events.summary: Sarkhan is sent back in time from the valley, and Sorin's Restoration awakens Ugin, breaking the crucible.
events.quote: Sarkhan Vol was sent back in time from this location

events.summary: Sarkhan goes through the Nexus of Fate and saves Ugin by encasing him in hedrons; Sorin's Restoration later frees him in 4559.
events.quote: In 4559 Sorin's Restoration broke the crucible and restored Ugin to life.
